title: STAT3-mediated ferroptosis is involved in ulcerative colitis.
authors: Huang, Fangfang; Zhang, Suzhou; Li, Xiaoling; Huang, Yuge; He, Shasha; Luo, Lianxiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究STAT3介导的铁死亡在溃疡性结肠炎中的作用，仅涉及STAT3作为转录因子的表达与磷酸化，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ferroptosis is a form of iron-dependent lipid peroxidation cell death that plays an important role in inflammation. However, the mechanism of ferroptosis in ulcerative colitis (UC) remains to be further investigated. In the present study, we merged the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) of UC in GEO database with the ferroptosis-related genes of FerrDb for bioinformatics analysis and successfully screened out the ferroptosis-related hub gene STAT3 (signal transducer and activator of transcription 3). Then we further validated the role of STAT3-mediated ferroptosis in vitro and in vivo models of colitis. The results showed that ferroptosis was increased in DSS-induced colitis, salmonella typhimurium (S. Tm) colitis and H(2)O(2)-induced IEC-6 cells. And the phosphorylation level of the hub gene STAT3 was down-regulated in IEC-6 cells treated with H(2)O(2), while Fer-1, an ferroptosis inhibitor, reactivated the phosphorylation level of STAT3. In addition, co-treatment of cells with H(2)O(2) and STAT3 inhibitor (stattic) showed an additive effect on the extent of ferroptosis. Taken together, these findings suggest that ferroptosis is closely associated with the development of colitis and ferroptosis-related gene STAT3 could serve as a potential biomarker for diagnosis and treatment of ulcerative colitis.
abstract_zh: 铁死亡是一种铁依赖性脂质过氧化细胞死亡形式，在炎症中发挥重要作用。然而，铁死亡在溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）中的机制仍需进一步研究。在本研究中，我们将GEO数据库中UC的差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）与FerrDb中的铁死亡相关基因进行合并，进行生物信息学分析，并成功筛选出铁死亡相关枢纽基因STAT3（信号转导与转录激活因子3）。随后，我们在体外和体内结肠炎模型中进一步验证了STAT3介导的铁死亡的作用。结果表明，在DSS诱导的结肠炎、鼠伤寒沙门氏菌（salmonella typhimurium, S. Tm）结肠炎以及H(2)O(2)诱导的IEC-6细胞中，铁死亡水平增加。并且，在H(2)O(2)处理的IEC-6细胞中，枢纽基因STAT3的磷酸化水平下调，而铁死亡抑制剂Fer-1则重新激活了STAT3的磷酸化水平。此外，将细胞与H(2)O(2)和STAT3抑制剂（stattic）共处理，对铁死亡程度显示出叠加效应。综上所述，这些发现表明铁死亡与结肠炎的发展密切相关，铁死亡相关基因STAT3可能作为溃疡性结肠炎诊断和治疗的潜在生物标志物。
